subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR path or ask for a fresh same-repo repair for the cron minute-zero stagger bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the only open closing PR is a fork PR that cannot be maintainer-edited and still needs semantic review around Croner-compatible minute parsing.

options.title: Create or adopt a narrow same-repo repair
options.body: Use the existing fork diff and discussion as context, then land a Croner-compatible helper plus persisted-path regression coverage in a branch maintainers can edit.

options.title: Repair the existing fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author to rebase, address helper semantics, and provide proof, accepting that maintainers cannot directly push fixes there.

options.title: Reject broader default staggering
options.body: If maintainers decide step/list/range minute-zero schedules should not auto-stagger, close this issue and update docs/tests to make that contract explicit.

recommendation.title: Create or adopt a narrow same-repo repair
recommendation.body: Use the existing fork diff and discussion as context, then land a Croner-compatible helper plus persisted-path regression coverage in a branch maintainers can edit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the default stagger helper and service integration that define the affected behavior.
